intro: The forms visitors and clients write in: contact, newsletter, consultation request, document request, custom training, sign in, and completing the account. Errors say what happened and what to do, and nothing promises a reply time.
staticNote: Still pictures of the states: nothing here is sent.

states.filed: After sending · the request in your record

contact.title: Contact form
contact.intro: No account needed. Name and email side by side, the organization type as one choice, then the message.

newsletter.title: Newsletter signup
newsletter.intro: On the home page, after an article and in the footer. After sending: “check your email”, so nobody is added before they confirm.

consultation.title: Consultation request
consultation.intro: The service and organization, a short title, what you're facing, and attachments. Once sent, the request is a record in your account.

dialog.title: Document request dialog
dialog.intro: The chosen documents, the purpose, then send. The decision is Ahmed's.

training.title: Custom training request
training.intro: Number of trainees, the topic, a suggested date, the place.

signIn.title: Sign in and sign up
signIn.intro: Clerk's components in the system's font and colours with square corners, in Arabic through arSA, with the reason for an account beside them. Emails and codes read left to right.
signIn.heading: Sign in
signIn.passwordError: That password isn't right. Try again or reset it.

onboarding.title: Completing the account
onboarding.intro: The phone reads left to right, optional fields say so in words, consent comes last. Then it goes back to what they started.
